summary: Fees were raised by both sides in the first round and remained part of integrated settlement term sheets before final class relief was settled. Class counsel privately considered their firms’ fee economics when formulating counters. The transcript does not clearly show an explicit trade of class recovery for fees, plaintiff prioritization of firm recovery over the class, defense fee-leverage, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
